title: Kummer Scalar Restriction
statement: For the actual all-continuous E→Omega coefficient map, define exact derived restriction and ordinary tensor extension. The unit is x↦1⊗x. The derived direct-image restriction comparison is the right-adjoint mate of the normalized scalar/pullback isomorphism, without a flatness hypothesis. The source coefficient map is the image of that ordinary unit followed by this mate and the exact scalar/pullback comparison. Built from [def-sfb-all-continuous-scalar-mate], [def-sfb-kummer-term-mate], [def-sfb-coefficient-map], [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull].
